page: Microsoft Azure M32bs_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MBSMediumMemoryv3 family. It is powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8473C processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The server features 32 vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 4.0 GHz. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage or onboard GPUs, relying instead on external block storage with Premium Storage capabilities.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong capabilities in single-core and multi-threaded operations. The server achieves a top-tier Geekbench single-core score of 2210.0 and a strong multi-core score of 18347.0. Cryptographic and compression tasks perform well, with single-threaded gzip compression reaching 33.05 GB/sec and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 210.74 GB/sec. The processor's Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512 support contribute to efficient execution of vector and matrix operations, as demonstrated by a top-tier text generation speed of 343.5 tokens/second on small language models. However, large-scale LLM text generation is a notable bottleneck, yielding a weak throughput of 2.74 tokens/second due to the absence of dedicated GPU acceleration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the M32bs_v3 offers a high-density memory-to-CPU ratio suitable for memory-intensive workloads without the overhead of local storage hardware. It is optimized for enterprise applications, in-memory databases, static web serving, and software compilation tasks. The instance is also well-suited for medium-scale data processing and text-processing workloads that benefit from its large L3 cache of 105 MB and dedicated Intel Xeon architecture.
